items.title: Maria Schneider interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 12, 2001
items.q: You got John Levy to be your manager. ... I never in a million years thought he’d take me on. And I sat down with him ... I showed him my whole schedule for the year.

ctx.x: the logistics of the phone calls, the money, the contracts, being on top of it, and now I’ve finally just got a manager so that’s going to be much better.
I heard that. You got John Levy to be your manager.
Yeah. Who’d you hear that from?
